values.note: Five campgrounds with 82 campsites (19 electric, in Marshall Cove and Red Lodge Arm) plus three group areas. Single sites' max vehicle lengths run 18-58 ft on ReserveAmerica, a few of them pull-throughs; six double electric pull-throughs at Red Lodge Arm take 80 ft (two camping units). Rigs, boats and trailers must fit entirely within the spur.

note: MT state park on Cooney Reservoir in south-central MT near Roberts, 40 minutes south of Billings; the area's most popular summer recreation spot. Three boat ramps with docks. --Claude
